notes.title: Update Notes :: February 03, 2021
notes.notes:
Update notes
-Fixed some unexpected bugs.
-The jump has been improved.
-Gamepad input has been updated.
-Gamepad Force Feedback has been added.
-Gamepad shortcut does not appear properly in the main menu.
-We will patch it as soon as possible.

-Main menu localization has been applied correctly.
(Japanese, Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional), Russian, German, Korean, Spanish, French, Italian)
-Some sentences may not be translated properly.

notes.title: Update Note :: February 01 2021
notes.notes:
-A negative delta time crash has been reported.
-Currently, play using the game pad is unstable.

We will update it as soon as possible. (It is expected to take 3-4 days.)

-Epilogue story will be added. More details will be released soon.

-Some unexpected bugs have been fixed.
